notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four basic lands.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Phylath.
Put all the Phylath tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Phylath tokens enters-the-battlefield abilities trigger, creating at least twenty 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.
